findings: The 256-device pure-idle trial failed during setup, before measured idle/probe phases.

The failing device reported a WebSocket upgrade failure before its warmup round timed out. The largest sampled event-loop delay was 251 ms; the available trace does not identify a server capacity threshold.
A later trial with 256 connected devices and eight active devices converged, kept up, completed observations and drained.
Therefore the earlier failure does not establish a 256-device connection ceiling. A repeated pure-idle trial is still required.

findings: Setup failed before exercise: three WebSocket closures occurred within 15 ms at different connection ages (32, 256 and 284 seconds).
There was no server instance change. Peak visible cgroup memory was below half the 2 GiB limit, and the client host-memory guard did not fire.
This does not identify OOM, a uniform idle timeout, or an established-stream ceiling. The separate 1024-device trial completed setup, idle hold, resumed delivery, exact verification and cleanup.
